comment: The gate and velocity jacks are read with getVoltage, so only channel 0 of a polyphonic cable is used. The maker names the jacks Gate 0 to Gate 11 and Velocity 0 to Velocity 11 in the tooltips (DrumMapper.cpp:147 and 150), counting from zero, while the panel names each pair after the drum it is currently mapped to. This module has no parameters at all; the drum names are plain widgets.
